input.description: deot add table <pdf> -p <page> --x <x> --y <y> (--rows n --columns n | --cells <json> | both) [--column-widths w,w,...] [--header true|false (true)] [--overflow error|allow]. --x, --y is the table's top-left corner. --cells is a JSON list of rows, each a list of cell texts ([["Word","Meaning"],["apple","사과"]], inline or @file; "" for an empty cell); with --rows and --columns it must have that shape, without them it sets them. Rows and columns 1-100 (the app's grid offers 10 × 10; its tables grow past that). Columns are 80 pt wide unless --column-widths (at least 16 pt each); rows are 24 pt high and grow with their text. Cells use the app's default text style (Malgun Gothic 12 pt, black, as a new text box); with --header the first row is bold on a light gray fill. Lines black 0.75 pt. A table reaching past the page fails with PAGE_OVERFLOW (2) unless --overflow allow (then a warning). Common: -p <page> (number or page ID), [--source-key k] [--group-key k] [--lock], -o <pdf> [--overwrite] | --dry-run, [--preview png|folder] [--expect-hash h] [--batch-id id] [--flatten]. The annotation is tagged author "ai" with the batch id; a source key an AI annotation already has replaces it (same ID and stacking position; another page moves it there on top). Errors: INVALID_ARGUMENT, PAGE_OVERFLOW (2), SOURCE_KEY_KIND_MISMATCH (2), DUPLICATE_SOURCE_KEY (2), PAGE_NOT_FOUND, SAME_AS_INPUT, OUTPUT_EXISTS, HASH_MISMATCH (3), FILE_OPEN_IN_APP (3).

x.description: left edge of the table (its outer line is centered on it)

cells.description: rows of cell texts [["a","b"],["c","d"]] (or a JSON string / @file)

columnWidths.description: one width per column in pt (at least 16), e.g. [90, 140] or "90,140"

header.description: first row is a header row (bold, gray fill); default true

out.description: -o output PDF; must differ from the input; an existing file needs --overwrite

preview.description: a .png path or a folder for renders of the changed pages

expectHash.description: refuse (exit 3 HASH_MISMATCH) when the input's sourceHash differs

appFolder.description: PdfNotes settings folder holding the window markers (default: the app's)

replaced.description: an AI annotation with the same source key was replaced (its ID is kept)

previousPage.description: the page the replaced annotation was on, when it moved to another page
